mechanism: Conditional commodity transmission: prior complete methanol rise may add repair information when the stock has not risen cumulatively from Q close through T close.
novelty: A fixed z*S interaction beyond all main terms; broad delayed-reflection theory was already proposed in EX008. No positive mechanism evidence established in this review.
parent: Original low-open positive-close parent A; all environments, not low environment only.
timing: T close decision; P is latest CZCE date strictly before T; Q is predecessor of P; K is contract mapped at P. Existing availability cutoff applies.
commodity_state: z=1[Close(K,P)/Close(K,Q)-1>0]; zero is non-up; missing is missing.
stock_state: S=1[HFQ_Close(T)/HFQ_Close(Q)-1<=0]; require exact Q stock close, no forward fill or substitute date.
stock_state_limit: Cumulative nonrise does not prove failure to respond; an earlier rise and subsequent reversal or firm-specific negative information are competing explanations.
method: Existing standardized ridge alpha10, annual mature-train threshold q75, selected score>=threshold
training_maturity: Actual exit maturity strictly before first common full-signal evaluation date of each year, not first parent A; identical rows for all three models; q75 from all training scores
common_rows: Same complete common training and evaluation rows across all three models; exclusions and calendar mismatches disclosed before fitting.
horizon_limit: Reuse immutable existing labels only. H1 describes the same selected opportunities, never a replacement target or another fitted horizon.
primary_comparison: Four-cell difference: (mean(Y3|z1,S1)-mean(Y3|z0,S1))-(mean(Y3|z1,S0)-mean(Y3|z0,S0)); predictive association, not causal effect.
allocation_comparison: mean_A((selected_M2-selected_M1)*Y3), plus M1-M0, absolute selected net outcomes, added/removed opportunities, all-parent and fixed z1&S1 participation comparisons.
counterevidence: Holding-overlap clusters, leave-one-cluster-out and top-contribution sensitivity
Inherited stock/market/sector current and lagged main controls
Old-five-stock-session commodity direction four-cell description, no extra fit
interpretation: No new economic hard gates. A relative loss reduction without entry utility does not establish a buy component. Describe uncertainty and competing explanations; no causal claim or independent confirmation claim.
stop: Close this fixed interaction branch if full-main-term controls remove increment, benefit is concentrated in isolated episodes, or stock reversal explains it better. Do not switch to low-environment H1 or search neighboring thresholds/windows/directions.
account_bridge: Before any separately authorized account trial, explain signal frequency capacity (at least 83 closed trades for a standalone strategy), holding conflicts, and exact strategy use. H3 evidence does not automatically authorize filtering C0056 H10.
exposure: All existing development evidence has been seen; this is an adaptive hypothesis, not independent confirmation.
authorization: 同意，按此开展甲醇上涨与股票累计不涨的固定交互检验，最多12次拟合，失败计入，不新增数据调用或账户实验。保持费用、执行约定和年度目标不变，你自主推进，我看结果。
